1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS & CONDITIONS (ATC) Hiring of Backhoe Loader (JCB) for Site Prepara tion, Soil Filling and Pit Digging Work 1. Name and Scope of Work Hiring of Backhoe Loader (JCB) for carrying out site preparation, soil filling, land levelling and pit digging activities at IB VALLEY AREA, SAMLESWARI, JHARSUGUDA, DISTRICT JHARSUGUDA, ODISHA, for the develop ment of an assigned plantation area of approximately 5 hectares (5 Ha.). 2. Location of Work The entire work shall be executed specifically at: IB VALLEY AREA, SAMLESWARI, JHARSUGUDA, ODISHA, INDI A. The contractor shall ensure the deployment of the Backhoe Loader (JCB) at the above-mentioned site. The work is strictly location-specific and shall be carried out within the designated plantation area of IB Valley, Samleswari, Jharsuguda, Odisha, as identified and instructed by the concerned site authority. For site coordination and work-related communication, the contact person shall be: Contact Person: Dr. ANSHUMAN DAS Mobile No.: 8250856331 3. Scope of Activities The hired Backhoe Loader (JCB) shall be utilized for the following activities as pe r site requirements and instructions of the authorized representative: Site preparation and initial land development. Soil filling, shifting and spreading wherever required. Levelling and dressing of the designated plantation area. Digging of pits for plantation purposes. Removal of unwanted soil, debris and minor obstructions, wherever necess ary. Other allied earthwork activities related to plantation site preparation. All activities shall be carried out in the assigned plantation area of approximatel y 5 hectares.

4. Contract Period Details Particulars 01.12.2026 Contract Start Date 31.12.2026 Contract End Date Total Contract Period 01 Month 6.5 Hours Working Hours per Day 10 Days Working Days per Month 65 Hours Total Scheduled Working Hours 5. Deployment of Machinery The contractor shall arrange and deploy a suitable Backhoe Loader (JCB) in goo d working condition at IB Valley Area, Samleswari, Jharsuguda, Odisha, as per th e requirement and directions of the authorized site representative. The machinery shall be suitable for carrying out site preparation, soil filling and pit digging activities. 6. Execution and Supervision The work shall be carried out strictly at IB Valley Area, Samleswari, Jharsug uda, Odisha. The contractor shall coordinate with Dr. Anshuman Das or the authorized site representative before commencement of work. The deployment schedule and daily activities shall be finalized in consultati on with the site-in-charge. The contractor shall maintain proper coordination to ensure timely complet ion of the assigned work. 7. Measurement and Certification of Work The working hours and days shall be recorded and certified by the authorized si te representative. Payment shall be processed as per the approved contract/wo rk order terms and duly certified deployment records. 8. Safety and Compliance The contractor shall ensure that: The JCB operator is adequately experienced and competent.

All applicable safety precautions are followed during execution. The machinery is maintained in safe and operational condition. No damage is caused to existing plantation, infrastructure or other site faci lities. 9. General Conditions All work shall be executed as per the instructions of the authorized representati ve and the actual requirements of the plantation development activity. The cont ractor shall ensure that the machinery is deployed at the specified location, i.e. IB Valley Area, Samleswari, Jharsuguda, Odisha, during the agreed contra ct period. 10. Submission The above terms and conditions are submitted for consideration and further nec essary action towards hiring/deployment of a Backhoe Loader (JCB) for the prop osed plantation site development work. Submitted for kind consideration and further necessary action. . 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
